desc: Identify the equivalence: a completion exists iff no fixed white cell is dominated by a fixed black cell (black row >= white row and black col >= white col).
Implement the O(M log M) sweep: store B as (-x, 0, y), W as (-x, 1, y), sort, scan maintaining max_y_black, handle same-row ordering, output Yes/No.
Verify edge cases and samples: same-row B/W, same-column B/W, W at y=1, B at y=N, M=0, large N, and the four sample inputs.
